source.requested_page_index_note: No individual page index was supplied; the user requested the entire PDF.

extraction.method: Apple Vision accurate OCR, ko-KR and en-US; automatic language correction disabled
extraction.text_policy: OCR hypotheses are preserved without spelling, grammar, punctuation, or example completion. Newlines separate detected text observations. OCR itself can omit or misrecognize source text.
limitations: This is an OCR draft, not a fully verified transcription.
All 425 PDF pages are included; no page index was inferred from printed book numbering.
Low-confidence or small-print spans are retained verbatim and flagged, rather than guessed or silently completed.
High OCR confidence does not guarantee correct punctuation, symbols, or complete detection; omissions cannot always be localized.
Semantic categories and example pair associations are heuristic and marked uncertain.
Diagrams and illustrations are represented only by detected text and its coordinates; visual content is not reconstructed.
Instructions printed inside the textbook are transcribed as source content and were not executed.
extraction.bbox_coordinates: Normalized [0,1] coordinates, origin at top left.
extraction.uncertain_span_offsets: Zero-based Python Unicode code point offsets in the corresponding line text; end is exclusive.
extraction.marker_policy: Preserve raw recognized markers and flag their interpretation. No marker is inferred from grammatical correctness.
extraction.line_identity: Line ids refer to original OCR observation order; reading_order_line_ids contains a separate approximate geometric reading order.
